reviews.review_text:
Thaison
Wales16 contributions
0
Thai eating in HCM City
May 2026 • Friends
Going to a Thai restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City that has only been opened 1 month ahould have been, at least, an ok experience? It wasn't! Sitting 2 older women, one obviously elderly, upstairs was not a good move. Air conditioning is inadequate so we asked to move to a table nearer A/C. Food arrived 1 plate at a time with at least 5 minute wait in between each dish! I ate the papaya salad which was quite good, I ate the cold grilled, tough steak because I was hungry. My friend ate some of her rice, tried the pork but couldn't battle fat to find meat and gave up trying! The pineapple rice served with undercooked prawn and something that ressembled wool was inedible, rice undercooked. At this point we gave up and told staff we would only pay for what we ate and drank. We didn't want dessert. The poor staff, obviously overwhelmed and, I think, perhaps under trained tried at best as they could and apologised profusely. But allowed us to pay for what we ate. The owner, a Vietnamese, was home so there appeared no guidance available for the young staff. On top of that the staff were not Thai - however perhaps the chefs are? But it was difficult for the staff to explain the Thai dishes, in English at least. The menu was overly large in my opinion - a smaller, more traditional menu might work better, for staff and customers. The place itself looks lovely. The staff try as best as they can over several floors but - maybe we came on the wrong night but rice was very undercooked and never going again

reviews.review_text:
William R M
6 contributions
0
BIG Disappointment
May 2025 • Solo
On my last trip to HCMC, I ate at this restaurant several times and always enjoyed the food and service. Today was a different story. I was looking forward to another good experience, but what an unfortunate surprise. I had to wait 20 minutes to be seated, not unexpected during lunch hour. After being seated, I waited another 20 minutes for a server to appear. When she did, she dropped off a menu and walked away. Never asking for a drink order. I flagged another server down to take my order: ice tea, satay appetizer, minced chicken with basil and rice. About 20 minutes later, my chicken arrived. No rice, no ice tea, no satay. I let my chicken sit until and asked for the rest of my order. Finally, I got, rice,, but still no tea or satay. By now, my chicken had gotten cold. As I tried to eat my cold chicken dish, my tea arrived, but still no satay. So I canceled that order. As I was disappointedly paying the check, another served showed up with the satay appetizer. I asked her to take it back and would not pay for it. The saddest thing to me is that no one seemed to care or be concerned, as if this was a common occurrence.
